definitions.explanation: A professional who operates trains, subways, or other rail vehicles.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{運転士|うんてんし}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become a train driver.

examples.japanese: {運転士|うんてんし}が{急|きゅう}ブレーキをかけた。
examples.english: The train driver applied the emergency brake.

examples.japanese: {運転士|うんてんし}は{安全|あんぜん}{確認|かくにん}を{徹底|てってい}している。
examples.english: Train drivers thoroughly check safety procedures.

notes:
FORMATION:
{運転|うんてん} (driving/operating) + {士|し} (professional suffix)

DISTINCTION:
・{運転士|うんてんし} - specifically for trains and rail vehicles
・{運転手|うんてんしゅ} - for cars, buses, taxis

The {士|し} suffix implies professional certification and expertise, while {手|しゅ} is more general.

RELATED PROFESSIONS:
・{車掌|しゃしょう} (train conductor)
・バス{運転手|うんてんしゅ} (bus driver)
・タクシー{運転手|うんてんしゅ} (taxi driver)
